title: Deeper/broader peer declared-limits and consumer-route refresh
scope: Reconcile advertised open-source DWG/DXF version matrices with each project's own unsupported, unstable, unhandled, and untested statements
Separate reader/writer version support from entity coverage, object-graph closure, raw carrier preservation, semantic geometry, and native-consumer acceptance
Refresh the exact FreeCAD and LibreCAD_3 consumer routes and identify whether an open-source independent ACIS semantic oracle is currently documented
Refine comparator evidence admission without adding routine tests, dependencies, fixtures, or support claims

sources.name: GNU LibreDWG current documentation
sources.assessment: The overview's approximately 99%/read-and-mostly-write headline coexists with explicit R2007 DWG writer absence, default R2004-or-earlier output, unstable/undertested classes, ACDSRECORD/ACDSSCHEMA pass-through without fields/DXF, and a list of entities/objects lacking test coverage. NEWS labels version 0.14 (2026-06-27) beta and describes R2004 writer work. Record exact artifact and actual output revision; headline percentages or version lists are not local per-feature evidence.

sources.name: ACadSharp README and reader guide
sources.assessment: The README provides direction-by-version read/write check marks through AC1032; the generic reader sample and notifications do not establish per-entity semantic preservation or native writer acceptance. Retain it as an optional exact-case independent implementation differential, not format authority.

sources.name: FreeCAD official DXF/DWG documentation and source route
sources.assessment: Stock DWG uses external converter then a selected DXF importer; built-in C++ and optional legacy Python importers have distinct coverage, and the official guide says the stock importer cannot read ACIS/SAT solids. Bind exact backend/preferences and separately record converter, intermediate DXF, importer, and created geometry.

sources.name: Open CASCADE official exchange documentation/catalog
sources.assessment: ACIS SAT/SAB exchange is listed among commercial components, distinct from standard open-source OCCT exchange capabilities. Do not infer an ACIS reader or independent semantic oracle from the open-source kernel alone.

sources.name: LibreCAD_3 DWG support policy
sources.assessment: DWG import is opt-in/off by default and read-only; writing is not implemented/exposed/planned pending explicit project gates, and the published ledger is reader-direction only. Scope LibreCAD_3 compatibility to its reader and consumer contract.

limitations: Primary-source documentation/source audit only; no peer repository was built or executed, no external drawing was downloaded or admitted, and no native CAD application or independent ACIS kernel was run. Mutable master pages are route/scope evidence, not reproducible artifact qualification.
